title: A Cipher for the Ghost
author: Beatrix Kavanagh
blurb: Bram Delacroix, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
